purpose: Freeze the Cohort-001 baseline/ablation gauntlet and successive-halving rules before any cheap-screen outcomes are opened, so simple baselines cannot be substituted after seeing results.

cheap_stage.execution: Run every semantically admitted and data-ready Cohort-001 candidate in deterministic parallel; do not serial-rank cheap OHLCV screens.

held_candidate.reason: HOLD_ACTIVE_OWNERSHIP_COLLISION with canonical COORD-DATA-005 / DATA-BREADTH-001 unless ownership is durably released/reconciled.

data_blocked_candidate.reason: Exclude until issue #520 reaches DATA_READY_FOR_FROZEN_CONSUMER for the frozen spot/perp/funding contract.

baseline_generation_rules.formation_timing: Generate candidate signals and baseline schedules from frozen inputs/rules before reading any forward return used to score candidate or baseline.

randomized_timing.eligible_pool: Decision timestamps satisfying the candidate's frozen data availability, warmup, chronology and non-overlap rules.
randomized_timing.matching: Match candidate event count and long/short counts separately within training and validation; choose timestamps without replacement by deterministic SHA256(seed|timestamp|direction) rank.

baseline_generation_rules.delayed_signal: Shift the candidate entry by exactly one completed 1h bar, preserve original signal direction, holding period and non-overlap semantics; do not recompute the signal with future bars.
baseline_generation_rules.costs: Every baseline uses the same fee/spread/slippage/funding semantics as the candidate unless the baseline necessarily changes leg count; if leg count changes, apply the same per-leg cost model transparently.
baseline_generation_rules.independence: Use the same independent-event/non-overlap accounting as the candidate whenever comparable; never increase sample size by counting overlapping realizations.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Equal-weight BTC/ETH/SOL basket direction over the same 6h holding windows without the low-dispersion filter.
additional_falsifiers: Single-asset BTC direction proxy on the same decision windows.
Equal-weight basket buy/hold beta over matched 6h windows.
One-bar delayed candidate signal.
Frequency- and direction-matched randomized eligible-window timing.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Simple follower 6h reversal with the same follower universe/hold/costs but no beta residualization or correlation gate.
additional_falsifiers: Unhedged follower reversal using the candidate residual sign.
Beta-hedged residual reversion without the correlation gate.
One-bar delayed candidate signal.
Frequency- and direction-matched randomized timing for the beta-hedged pair.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Simple 4h price momentum with the same 3h hold and no quote-volume-pressure condition.
additional_falsifiers: Signed-volume pressure rule without the close-location gate.
One-bar delayed candidate signal.
Frequency- and direction-matched randomized timing.
Explicit diagnostic label that signed candle-body volume is an OHLCV proxy, not authenticated aggressive order flow.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Simple 8h move reversal with the same 6h hold and no low-participation condition.
additional_falsifiers: Same move gate with ordinary/high participation rather than low participation.
Same move gate without the shock-exclusion filter.
One-bar delayed candidate signal.
Frequency- and direction-matched randomized timing.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Unconditional opposite-direction Monday reversal after the same fixed Friday-22:00-to-Sunday-23:00 UTC weekend window.
additional_falsifiers: Weekend move gate without the participation filter.
Weekday pseudo-weekend placebo using the same elapsed duration and clock offset where chronology permits.
One-bar delayed Monday entry.
Do not loosen thresholds or add weeks post hoc if sample power is insufficient.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Plain three-bar same-sign continuation with the candidate holding period and no moderate-volatility filter.
additional_falsifiers: Same continuation rule without the volatility-state restriction.
One-bar delayed candidate signal.
Sign-shuffled or frequency-matched randomized timing baseline.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Simple range-edge reversal with the same hold/costs but without the low-efficiency/auction condition.
additional_falsifiers: Generic short-horizon reversal with matched hold.
One-bar delayed candidate signal.
Frequency- and direction-matched randomized timing.

candidate_baselines.primary_mechanism_baseline: Always-on delta-neutral spot/perpetual hedge under the same frozen venue/instruments/capital accounting.
additional_falsifiers: Positive-funding rule without any additional filter.
No-trade/cash.
One actual funding-event delayed entry.
1x/2x/3x candidate-consistent fee, spread, slippage and financing stress.
Never treat future realized funding as known at entry.

hard_requirements: Candidate minus primary mechanism baseline > 0 in training.
Candidate minus primary mechanism baseline > 0 in validation.
Candidate minus relevant ablation > 0 in training and validation when an ablation is defined.
One-bar delayed and randomized/placebo baselines must not equal or exceed the candidate in both training and validation.
Any result dominated by catastrophic tail or a single winner is rejected regardless of baseline margin.
stage_2_incremental_value_gate.complexity_rule: If a simpler baseline captures the same or better after-cost economics, reject/deprioritize the complex candidate; complexity has no independent value.

medium_stage_ranking.tie_break: Prefer stronger independent-event support, then simpler executable mechanism; never use headline win rate as tie-break.

early_shadowing.eligible_after: A candidate is canonically frozen/admitted and passes a legitimate development cheap screen plus baseline gate.
